title: Inside the long, bitter fight over one man’s quest to build the biggest AI datacenter in California
hook_text: Sebastian Rucci's massive California AI datacenter
script:
Sebastian Rucci wants to build the biggest AI datacenter in California.
His ambitious quest has triggered a long and bitter local fight.
The project secured three hundred thirty megawatts of electricity to operate.
Nearby Imperial County residents worry about severe power grid strain.
A county judge ruled the facility cannot proceed without an extensive environmental review.
Will this legal roadblock permanently halt the massive energy drain?
